reason: This is not a routine fix: it changes multiple core planner and executor paths (`builder`, `distsql`, `mem_reader`, `union_scan`, physical-plan generation, best-task selection) to make global indexes work with `memIndexReader`. That combination directly affects access path selection and runtime row/index correctness, especially for partitioned/global-index reads and in-memory/union-scan behavior, where wrong results or missed rows are plausible high-severity failures.
